title: 情報工学専門実験・演習Ａ
subtitle: Information and Computer Science Major Lab/Exercises A
teachers:
NAKAZAWA Minoru
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
In this course, students will learn programming techniques, wireless network technologies, and data collection methods via evaluation of wireless sensor networks with a microcontroller.
They will also be given opportunities to master knowledge regarding the Internet and security using routers and switches, gain knowledge and skill via investigations and exercises related to IPv4/IPv6, and study how to control networks via packet capture.
advice:
This course covers the following topics:
1. Embedded programming with c and python language
2. Wireless network technologies for IoT systems
3. Communication protocols toward IoT systems
4. Information network construction method
5. Analysis of information transmission path by network capturing
6. Implementation of network capture program using C / C ++

NOTE:
A review of Programming I, Programming II, Fundamental Computer Architecture, and Information Networks is required.
requiredKnowledge:
Students of this course are expected to have the following:
1. C and Python programming skills.
2. Understanding of CPU, main memory, and register on an embedded processor.
3. Knowledge and skill related to the construction of information networks.
4. Knowledge related to information transmissions using packet capturing tools.
5. Understanding of packet capture implementation techniques.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain wireless technologies such as wireless LAN, ZigBee, and LoRaWAN.
Be able to explain a data collection method via MQTT.
Be able to design and evaluate a wireless sensor network.
Be able to explain network hierarchical structures.
Be able to understand Internet traffic using packet capture.
Be able to set a personal IP address on a personal computer.
